description:
Perform terrain analysis on a Digital Elevation Model (DEM).

1. Open QGIS (it should already be running).
2. Load the DEM raster file located at `/home/ga/GIS_Data/rasters/bay_area_dem.tif`.
3. Generate a Hillshade map: Go to Raster > Analysis > Hillshade. Set the Input layer to the DEM. Set Azimuth to 315, Altitude to 45. Save the output to file `/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/hillshade.tif` (GeoTIFF format).
4. Generate a Slope map: Go to Raster > Analysis > Slope. Set the Input layer to the DEM. Ensure the output is in Degrees. Save the output to file `/home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/slope.tif` (GeoTIFF format).
5. Save the entire QGIS project as `terrain_analysis.qgz` in `/home/ga/GIS_Data/projects/`.

Ensure all output files are saved correctly.
